cases.story: A day's 1,300 placements compressed into business hours, with a 10x burst at 9am; workers and recruiters submit forms; every commit triggers a reconcile pull.
cases.checked: P1 and P2 bars hold through the burst; no writer waits over 2 s.
domainClaims: each reconcile pull's next task (O-DOMAIN)

cases.story: A worker submits I-9 Section 1 (10 facts); the reconcile pull runs immediately at the returned tx.
cases.checked: The next task is visible on the first pull, every time; commit p99 <= 50 ms under scenario 1's load.
domainClaims: the next task after Section 1 is visible on the first pull (O-DOMAIN; fails closed until EXP-D01)

cases.story: 1,000 duplicate E-Verify status signals across 100 subjects in 10 s, out of order. Added schedule: a vendor's older revision of a status arrives after a newer one for the same subject.
cases.checked: Exactly-once receipts; no read sees a half-applied command; per-subject order kept. GS.03: the late older revision is acknowledged as superseded, current values do not change, and it is recorded in the journal.
domainClaims: a revision older than the applied one is acknowledged as superseded (W0 rule; O-DOMAIN, fails closed until EXP-D01; provisional, flagged for Sam in TARGETS 6.1)

cases.story: 1% of commits lose their ACK and are retried; mid-run, the engine (or QLever broker) is killed and restarted. Added schedule GS.04b: the current index's feed consumer is cut for 60 s while the source keeps committing.
cases.checked: Every retry returns the original receipt; no acknowledged commit is lost; readers resume at their pinned bases. GS.04b: reads at bases beyond the index watermark wait or route to a fallback per TARGETS 4.1; none answers from the stale index.

cases.story: A vendor posts results for 5,000 subjects in 5 minutes while the UI reads.
cases.checked: Live read p99 holds; the feed reports every changed subject within the lag bar.
domainClaims: the background-check obligation of each changed subject is re-evaluated (O-DOMAIN)

cases.story: A single decision fans out as 50 per-subject commands driven by persisted messages. Added schedule GS.06b: a work location's minimum wage changes (one shared referenced entity).
cases.checked: Each subject commits once, in order; no cross-subject transaction; all 50 visible to their next pulls. GS.06b: every worker at that location appears in the feed's affected-subject set and is re-run; no other worker is.
domainClaims: GS.06b affected-subject set = exactly the loc1 workers, all re-run (O-DOMAIN dependency rule over the :placement/location reference)
pay-rate-at-or-above-minimum-wage obligations after the change (O-DOMAIN)

cases.story: Two reviewers approve and waive the same subject at the same moment, 500 times across subjects.
cases.checked: Compare-and-set lets exactly one win per race; the loser gets a typed conflict, never a silent overwrite.

cases.story: Valid-time corrections 30 days back on 1,000 subjects during live traffic.
cases.checked: The feed reports the valid-time range; derived state is re-run; explain at the old basis still shows the old belief.
domainClaims: derived state of each corrected subject is re-run (O-DOMAIN affected set; fails closed until EXP-D01)

cases.story: 2,000 placement start dates shift forward and back, moving obligations.
cases.checked: Next-boundary times recompute; reads at bases on both sides of a boundary are exact.
domainClaims: obligations moved by the new start dates and their next-boundary times (O-DOMAIN; Triplex dependencyState.nextTemporalBoundary is the database-side witness)

cases.story: A new release changes 3 requirements; activation is a fact; the sweep re-reconciles 100k subjects at one pinned basis with live traffic. Added schedule (Q38f): release rollback R1, then R2, then R1 again.
cases.checked: P5 bars (sweep <= 100 s, live p99 <= 1.5x); in-flight reconciles finish on the old release; every in-scope subject evaluated exactly once at the captured basis; subjects mutated after the basis was captured are swept as of the basis. Rollback: three activations commit in order; the changed notice is delivered three times, keyed (id, publication sequence) = 1, 2, 3 with payloads R1, R2, R1.
domainClaims: R2 evaluated for every in-scope subject at R_act and published as work items through the outbox (O-DOMAIN)
in-flight reconciles evaluate R1 (O-DOMAIN)
rollback R1 -> R2 -> R1 publishes three deliveries for a changed notice (O-DOMAIN payloads; delivery identity per Q38f)

cases.story: "Who gains work" for a candidate release over 100k subjects, without applying it, during live traffic.
cases.checked: Identical answer to the post-activation sweep (GS.10) at one common input basis; never blocks writers.
domainClaims: the preview of R2 at GS.10's R_act equals GS.10's sweep output at R_act (O-DOMAIN)

cases.story: Explain reads at a past basis for 1,000 subjects, repeated three times while writes continue.
cases.checked: Bit-for-bit identical answers across repeats and engines; as-of pull p99 reported. Numbers rule: an int64 overflow write fails typed; a 2^60 write is exact or a typed error.
domainClaims: the explanation (obligations and why) at (R_past, 2026-03-03) (O-DOMAIN)

cases.story: A 1M-fact import through the bulk lane while live traffic runs.
cases.checked: Live read p99 <= 1.5x; per-batch receipts; the bulk lane never starves live commits.

cases.story: A new tenant is provisioned with 10k entities and its first release while other tenants are live.
cases.checked: The new tenant is invisible to others at the storage layer; others' p99 holds.
domainClaims: the new tenant's first release activation evaluates its subjects (O-DOMAIN)

cases.story: One large tenant (1m entities) and 1,000 small tenants (1k each) under the same live load. Added schedule GS.15: a tenant-A route attempts to read tenant B's storage directly; one tenant's feed consumer is slowed 10x.
cases.checked: Storage-layer isolation; per-tenant pull and commit bars hold for large and small tenants. GS.15: the access fails at the storage layer; other tenants' feed lag and p99 hold.

cases.story: Erase PII for 10k subjects (crypto-shredding or real deletion) during live traffic.
cases.checked: Values are unrecoverable from every layer; history keeps its shape; explain still works. TARGETS 7: ErasedValue {erasedAt} at every basis after the erasure publishes; tests for a reader already pinned, a rebuild after erasure and a restore from a pre-erasure backup.
domainClaims: explain still works with markers in place of PII (O-DOMAIN explanation over erased inputs)

cases.story: Agents write drafts and proposals at 5x the human rate, most discarded.
cases.checked: Proposals never leak into decisions; pulls at a basis see exactly what was committed.
domainClaims: proposals never count as decisions (W0 rule; O-DOMAIN)

cases.story: "Placements in this branch with an overdue I-9" lists with filters, sort and paging at 256 concurrent readers.
cases.checked: Answers come from maintained projections, match the oracle, and keep stable cursors while writes continue.
domainClaims: which placements are overdue at a basis (W0 due rule; O-DOMAIN)

cases.story: The dependency-index consumer crashes mid-stream and resumes from its checkpoint. Added schedule GS.19b: the consumer crashes after delivering an outbox item but before recording completion. Q38f cases: a crash before delivery, and an unchanged activation (same payload) during recovery.
cases.checked: No gap, no duplicate processing, per-subject order kept; catch-up lag measured. Crash points: A before the effect, D after the durable outbox write but before delivery (Q38f), B after delivery before completion is recorded (GS.19b), C after the checkpoint. Deliveries are keyed (id, publication sequence); the set delivered equals the set implied by the committed stream (a new sequence only when the payload changes); the receiver shows exactly one visible effect per key while replays happen; the unchanged activation publishes nothing.
domainClaims: the dependency-index affected-subject set including subjects reached through referenced entities (O-DOMAIN)
work-item payloads and their publication sequences under W0 (O-DOMAIN); the harness payload is the asserted (attribute, value) set per subject

cases.story: 20,000 documents expire at midnight (valid-time boundaries) while morning traffic starts.
cases.checked: Every affected subject is re-run at the boundary; reads before and after midnight are exact; live p99 holds.
domainClaims: every expiring subject is re-run at the boundary and gains the re-verification obligation (O-DOMAIN)
